purpose: Small set of cross-tradition category records required to resolve relationships in the religious graph.

records.name: Christian eschatology
records.definition: Christian teachings and interpretations concerning the final destiny of humanity, resurrection, judgment, the Kingdom of God and related end-time themes.

records.name: Japanese religious traditions
records.definition: Umbrella category for religious traditions historically practiced in Japan, including Shinto, Buddhism and newer movements, with substantial internal diversity.

records.name: Historical pagan traditions
records.definition: Umbrella category for pre-Christian religious traditions and practices documented in historical societies; it does not imply a single unified ancient religion.

records.name: Religious experience
records.definition: Comparative category for reported experiences interpreted as encounters with the sacred, divine, transcendent or ultimate reality.

records.name: Religious change
records.definition: Comparative category covering conversion, reform, syncretism, schism, revival, secularization and other processes that alter religious traditions over time.

note: These are analytical categories, not claims that the traditions they connect form one organization or doctrine.
